chunks: And from him (Al-Hilli) from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Muawiya ibn Ayyar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"When you arrive at the Sanctuary, if God wills, perform the ritual bath (Ghusl) upon entering it. And if you advance (before entering), perform the bath from the Well of Maimun, or from Fakh, or from your house in Mecca." And it is recommended for whoever intends to enter the Sanctuary to take some of the Idhkhir (a type of aromatic herb) and chew it, for that is among what freshens the breath. He narrated that.
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended rituals for purity and freshness before entering the Sanctuary of Mecca?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the preparatory rituals for entering the Sanctuary of Mecca, emphasizing both physical purity through Ghusl and spiritual etiquette via chewing Idhkhir for fragrance. It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of linking bodily cleanliness with the reverence due to the sacred space, offering practical guidance for pilgrims on where and when to perform ablution before entering the Haram.
